data_order: NumPy default_rng(seed+epoch) permutation of all training windows; each epoch includes final short batch.
initialization: Random normal std .02, zero linear biases; tied embeddings/head; RMSNorm eps=1e-6; SwiGLU FFN.
optimizer: AdamW beta=(.9,.95), weight_decay=.1, clip=1, no fused/foreach; 5% warmup then cosine to 10%.
scope: Single trainer local experimental lineage; no Oracle or multi-host training claim.
selection: Minimum equal-domain validation NLL; test only initial and selected.
